options.model_note: Synthetic model label at a local endpoint, not a real Claude provider call

protocol: Three synthetic native Skill responses; third reports 185000 input tokens to trigger SDK auto-compaction. Local endpoint returns a synthetic summary and terminal. A second query resumes the observed session with an updated learner sidecar. Only sentinel presence and safe event metadata observed; no hidden reasoning archived.
limitations: Pre-token usage is deliberately synthetic. These figures are NOT measured token/cost savings.
Probe uses native SDK directly, not Hono/PG/production Copilot. Public runner and execution-owner tests separately verify product option/hook wiring.
Does not prove real provider summary quality, automatic thresholds for MiMo or production latency.
No invented compact method; PostCompact is observed only, reinjection uses the runtime-verified SessionStart compact event.
Initial product patch placed settings at the wrong nesting and overwrote hooks; initial independent review rejected it. Subsequent public-runner regressions cover those errors.
